I am a Data Scientist at the [Global Environment Facility - Independent Evaluations Office](https://www.gefieo.org/), where my primary responsibility is to extract information from monitoring and evaluation reports and identify common patterns across projects.

I earned my Ph.D. in [Agricultural and Applied Economics from the University of Wisconsin-Madison](https://aae.wisc.edu/) in 2018. My research interests focus on integrating data from large language models, satellite observations, and structured reports to assess the outcomes of interventions.
